/* hero: the banner photos fill the screen, the headline sits on a navy wash, the brand ribbon sweeps across the bottom */
.hx{position:relative;height:clamp(600px,88vh,800px);overflow:hidden;background:#373b73;color:#fff}

/* who we are: two overlapping photos */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.02fr);gap:clamp(36px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
.duo{position:relative;padding:0 14% 16% 0}
.duo img{display:block;width:100%;object-fit:cover}
.duo .a{aspect-ratio:5/4;border-radius:30px 30px 30px 120px}
.duo .b{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:0;width:52%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;border:10px solid #fbf7ee;box-shadow:0 20px 50px -20px rgba(43,46,110,.45)}
.duo .dot{position:absolute;left:-26px;top:-26px;width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;background:#f6b81f;opacity:.85;z-index:-1}
.since{position:absolute;left:24px;bottom:calc(16% + 24px);padding:12px 18px;border-radius:18px;background:#373b73;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;line-height:1.25}
.since b{display:block;font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:30px;color:#f6b81f}

/* chairman: portrait in a ring of the logo's four colours */
.chair{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:36px;background:#373b73;color:#fff;padding:clamp(28px,4.4vw,64px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,300px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(28px,4.4vw,64px);align-items:center}
.ring{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;padding:10px;background:conic-gradient(from 200deg,#59ba53 0 25%,#f6b81f 0 50%,#df2a2f 0 75%,#1f7fc4 0)}
.ring img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 18%;border-radius:50%;border:8px solid #373b73}
.chair blockquote{margin:0;font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(22px,2.2vw,30px);line-height:1.3;color:#fff}

.chair .who{margin:26px 0 28px;font-size:16px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}.chair .who b{display:block;font-size:19px;color:#fff}
.chair .blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%}

/* programmes in photo circles, five over four */
.circles{margin:52px auto 0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:40px 28px;max-width:1180px}
.pc{flex:0 0 200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;color:#373b73}
.pc-ph{position:relative;width:200px;height:200px}

.pc-ic{position:absolute;right:4px;bottom:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);color:#fff;border:4px solid #fff}
.pc b{font-family:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;font-weight:600;font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;max-width:200px}

/* flagship: a glass card over a full-width photo */
.flag{position:relative;min-height:clamp(420px,46vw,520px);padding:56px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;color:#fff}
.flag>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 40%}

.glass{position:relative;max-width:540px;padding:clamp(26px,3vw,40px);border-radius:28px;background:rgba(43,46,110,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);box-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}

/* news: one featured story and two more */
.newsx{margin-top:44px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:24px}
.nf{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;text-decoration:none;color:#2c2f5c;box-shadow:0 24px 60px -34px rgba(43,46,110,.4);transition:transform .25s ease}

.nf div{padding:26px 30px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}

.collage{position:relative;height:600px}
.pr{position:absolute;margin:0;padding:10px 10px 0;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 26px 50px -24px rgba(43,46,110,.5);transition:transform .35s ease}

.pr.p2{right:2%;top:0;width:46%;transform:rotate(4deg)}

.pr.p4{right:0;top:52%;width:46%;transform:rotate(-3deg)}
.collage .dot{position:absolute;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;background:#59ba53;opacity:.25;left:44%;top:40%}

.mrow img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.glabel{margin:34px 0 0;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#4f527a}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mrow{animation:none;flex-wrap:wrap;width:auto;justify-content:center;padding:0 clamp(20px,4vw,40px)}.mrow [aria-hidden]{display:none}.marq{-webkit-mask-image:none;mask-image:none}}

.cx .row{margin-top:34px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:14px}

<p class="lede" style="max-width:none">SOS Foundation is the Corporate Social Responsibility arm of SOS Group of Companies.
